artifact_semantics: Evidence of operator-approved treatment intent. NOT a substitute for the actual measured V4 prompt projection.

records.atomic_proposition: ChatGPT increased measured output quality by approximately 18% on the studied occupation-specific professional-writing tasks.
records.directly_demonstrates: Randomized ChatGPT exposure improved measured output quality on the studied professional-writing tasks.
records.does_not_demonstrate: CACOFÓNICO output quality; distinctive brand-voice quality; customer demand; willingness to pay; pricing power; category displacement.
records.geography: Geography not specified in recovered primary abstract.
records.laundering_guard: Never convert experimental writing-task quality into brand distinctiveness, market demand, CACOFÓNICO performance, or higher commercial value.
records.required_qualification: Preserve the experimental task, population, and measured-quality boundary.
records.source_title: Experimental evidence on the productivity effects of generative artificial intelligence

records.atomic_proposition: Surveyed brands expected to pay more for strategic and technical talent while fees for more commoditised or tech-enabled tasks were expected to fall.
records.directly_demonstrates: Survey respondents expressed differentiated future payment/fee expectations according to talent/task type.
records.does_not_demonstrate: Observed transaction-price changes; that CACOFÓNICO belongs in the strategic/technical category; distinctive brand voice becoming more valuable.
records.evidence_type: Brand-side survey plus interviews; more than 80 multinational companies.
records.laundering_guard: Never translate buyer expectations into transaction prices, CACOFÓNICO WTP, pricing power, or protection from AI.
records.locator: Paragraph beginning "Critically, the desire for change..."
records.required_qualification: This is payment/fee expectation evidence, not realized-price evidence or abstract value evidence.
records.source_title: Three-quarters of brands want to change their agency remuneration model / Future of Media Remuneration research

records.atomic_proposition: Substitutable freelance skill clusters such as writing/translation experienced estimated demand declines of approximately 20–50% relative to counterfactual trend.
records.directly_demonstrates: Estimated demand for specified substitutable freelance skill clusters declined materially relative to counterfactual trend following GenAI introduction.
records.does_not_demonstrate: A 20–50% decline in all writing; CACOFÓNICO demand decline; Mexico-specific effects; brand-voice transaction-price effects.
records.evidence_type: Longitudinal observational/quasi-experimental platform study; >3 million job postings.
records.geography: Global freelancing platform; effects not geographically disaggregated.
records.laundering_guard: Never generalize freelancer-platform effects to all writing, verbal identity, or CACOFÓNICO.
records.locator: Abstract; result concerning substitutable skills and counterfactual-trend comparison.
records.required_qualification: Preserve the skill-cluster restriction and relative-to-counterfactual-trend interpretation.
records.source_title: Winners and losers of generative AI: Early Evidence of Shifts in Freelancer Demand

records.directly_demonstrates: This provider publicly offers this exact positioning/narrative/guidelines block at 20,000 MXN.

records.laundering_guard: Do not combine with other prices into a Mexico range, cross-market ratio, average, median, or pricing recommendation.

records.atomic_proposition: STATEN publicly lists a $2,000 Strategic Messaging package with a 4–6 week duration and defined deliverables.
records.directly_demonstrates: A contained U.S. strategic-messaging offer with explicit public scope, duration, and price exists.
records.does_not_demonstrate: U.S. market average/range; actual transaction price; sales volume; buyer demand; WTP; CACOFÓNICO's correct price.
records.laundering_guard: Never promote one provider's public menu into a U.S. pricing benchmark.
records.source_quality: HIGH for provider-offer authenticity; LOW for market generalization

records.atomic_proposition: SuperBrand states custom messaging/strategy work begins at $7,500.
records.directly_demonstrates: A provider with a materially different, higher-starting custom messaging/strategy architecture exists.
records.does_not_demonstrate: A U.S. market upper/lower bound; market range; transaction price; sales volume; demand; WTP; CACOFÓNICO's price.
records.evidence_type: First-party provider menu / custom-engagement starting rate.
records.laundering_guard: Do not construct a price ladder or synthetic U.S. range from STATEN + SuperBrand.
records.locator: Our Process → Pricing → custom messaging/strategy paragraph.
records.required_qualification: $7,500 is a provider-specific starting rate for customized work, not a standardized package price.

records.atomic_proposition: Projectworks reports a 47% average proposal-stage win rate across its 45-firm professional-services survey.
records.cacofonico_applicability: MEDIUM as contextual reference-class evidence; LOW for threshold setting
records.directly_demonstrates: The source reports a proposal → win benchmark within its surveyed professional-services firms.
records.does_not_demonstrate: Cold contact → reply; reply → meeting; CACOFÓNICO proposal win rate; CAC; sales-cycle duration; any 90-day numerical threshold.
records.laundering_guard: 47% can never be reused as cold-outreach conversion, CACOFÓNICO proposal performance, or a validation threshold.
records.locator: "By the numbers," first paragraph; methodology below industry table.
records.required_qualification: Preserve proposal → win as the denominator and retain methodology limitations.
records.source_title: How to Win More Work | A Consultant's Guide to Growing Profitably in 2026

records.atomic_proposition: 78% of surveyed professional-services firms reported that closing a deal could take up to six months after the first meeting.
records.cacofonico_applicability: MEDIUM for contextual calibration; LOW for threshold setting
records.directly_demonstrates: Survey respondents reported deal-close durations extending up to six months after an initial meeting.
records.does_not_demonstrate: Total acquisition-cycle duration; CACOFÓNICO expected sales cycle; proof that 90 days is too short; CAC; numerical pass/fail threshold.
records.evidence_type: Vendor-produced cross-sectional survey; exact respondent N not publicly recovered.
records.laundering_guard: Never convert this statistic into CACOFÓNICO's forecast sales cycle or use it alone to justify altering a validation threshold.
records.locator: Introductory findings, second highlighted finding; first-meeting denominator clarified in same-publisher supporting material during verification.
records.required_qualification: Preserve first meeting → close and the respondent-reported nature of the statistic.
records.source_title: RSW/US 2025 Professional Services New Business Survey Report
